description: Stale-negative revocation (freshness): P→A→B→C; a boundary caches revocation state at epoch N; P revokes P→A at epoch N+1; the boundary, still at N, receives C's protected action and sees no tombstone.

rule.name: INV-04_revocation_freshness
rule.description: An enforcement boundary must not treat the absence of a visible revocation as proof of validity unless its observed epoch is fresh enough

action.reason: revocation state is stale relative to the boundary epoch (INV-04 freshness)
